column3: It walks (os.walk; node_modules, __pycache__ and the gitignored build output pruned) the style-bearing files (.css, .njk, .html, fonts*.json) under those Core folders and copies them, with the two sign-in theme files in harness/ by name, into a temporary folder that every plant is written into; the real-tree cases run the check itself over OspreyFlow_Core, which reads the same folders (packages/themes, under OspreyFlow_Core/packages/, is absent today and every case that needs it plants it in the temporary copy); two cases read OspreyFlow_Core/.gitignore; nothing real is written.
